proof_id_hash.description: Identifier hash of the proof that was registered.

issuer_address.description: Public address of the issuer that registered the proof.

schema_version.description: Approved schema version used by this proof.

created_ledger.description: Ledger sequence at which the proof was registered.

created_at.description: Ledger timestamp at which the proof was registered.

expires_at.description: Ledger timestamp at which the proof expires.

disclosure_policy_hash.description: SHA-256 commitment to the canonical selective-disclosure policy; all-zero denotes a legacy registration without a policy commitment.

proof_type.description: Numeric schema proof type selected at registration.

commitment_algorithm.description: Numeric commitment algorithm selected at registration.

epoch.description: Registry epoch after this registration committed. A cache or indexer may invalidate on this value alone instead of diffing individual records.

description: Published once a proof registration commits, carrying the public record fields, disclosure policy commitment, numeric policy identifiers, creation timing, and registry epoch but not the proof commitment or policy bytes.
